Verbatim on SRD page 30; pre-flight objective; the SRD plan differs from the as-run record (xenon, surrogate fuels never flown). Never upgrade.
Verbatim in section=hypothesis; names 'liquid hydrocarbon fuels' that match the as-run fuels; direct holds; negative control found no contradiction.
Verbatim on Final Report page 6 (post-flight procedures); droplet -> liquid derivation correct.
Verbatim on Final Report page 4; as-run platform statement; survived the negative control.
Verbatim in section=approach; SHARED_LINEAGE with FLEX supported by Final Report page 6.
Same sentence as R8; MDCA shared with FLEX and FLEX-2.
Verbatim on SRD page 45; pre-flight plan: ambiguous, never as-run.
Verbatim on SRD page 38; a 'shall' requirement on the gas before ignition: ambiguous.
Verbatim on SRD page 12 inside the FLEX section; MDCA capability, not a CFI test condition: ambiguous + SHARED_LINEAGE, weakest of R10-R12.
Verbatim on SRD page 38; '18 - 27 C' is a requirement range; must not populate an as-run temperature envelope.
Text layer reads '250 C' where the page shows 25 followed by a superscript degree sign; 250 would propagate as 523 K. Also a plan and an approximation duplicating R13. Drop.
The deck is a 2013 FLEX presentation (every results slide is 'ISS FLEX'), four years before CFI flew; the '_CFI' in the file name is a filing artefact.
